description.description: A bald, shirtless man in blue swim trunks and a young girl in a purple swimsuit are climbing stairs at a water park. They arrive at the top where there is a circular opening for a water slide. The man asks the girl if he can go first. The girl then sits down and prepares to enter the water slide.
